passages.text: There cannot be friendship without equality, and there cannot be equality when one party is always the teacher and the other party sits always at his feet.
passages.note: Friendship needs equality and mutual give and take

passages.text: Let me tell you, my friends, intellect is great indeed, but it stops within certain bounds. It is through the heart, and the heart alone, that inspiration comes.
passages.note: Limits of intellect; inspiration from the heart

passages.text: It is man that always makes money. The whole world has been made by the energy of man, by the power of enthusiasm, by the power of faith.
passages.note: Feeling poor or powerless; energy and faith matter more

passages.text: My Master used to say, he who thinks himself weak will become weak, and that is true.
